name: bamboohr-time-tracking
title: BambooHR - Time Tracking
description: Manage your time tracking on BambooHR
author: stonko1994

commands.name: clock-in
commands.title: Clock in
commands.description: Start time tracking by clocking in.

commands.name: clock-out
commands.title: Clock out
commands.description: Stops time tracking by clocking out

commands.name: get-timesheet
commands.title: Get Timesheet
commands.description: Show your timesheet for the current month

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: BambooHR API Key
preferences.description: Your BambooHR API key. You can find this in your BambooHR account under "API Keys".
preferences.placeholder: Enter your API key from BambooHR

preferences.name: companyDomain
preferences.title: BambooHR Subdomain
preferences.description: Your BambooHR subdomain. This is the part of your BambooHR URL before bamboohr.com. For example, if your BambooHR URL is https://company-name.bamboohr.com, your subdomain is "company-name".

preferences.name: employeeId
preferences.title: BambooHR User ID
preferences.description: Your user ID in Bamboo. Used to filter out your own information from the directory.

preferences.name: defaultPauseDuration
preferences.title: Default Pause duration (Minutes)
preferences.description: Gap inserted between split entries when pre-filling (e.g., 30).

preferences.name: splitMode
preferences.title: Split Entry Mode
preferences.description: How to calculate default split times when splitting entries.

preferences.name: maxWorkHours
preferences.title: Maximum Work Hours (After Max Hours Mode)
preferences.description: Maximum continuous work hours before requiring a break (e.g., 6). Only used when Split Entry Mode is 'After Maximum Hours'.

preferences.name: customSplitEndTime
preferences.title: First Entry End Time (Custom Times Mode)
preferences.description: Default end time for the first entry when splitting (HH:MM format, e.g., 12:00). Only used when Split Entry Mode is 'Custom Times'.

preferences.name: customSplitStartTime
preferences.title: Second Entry Start Time (Custom Times Mode)
preferences.description: Default start time for the second entry when splitting (HH:MM format, e.g., 13:00). Only used when Split Entry Mode is 'Custom Times'.

preferences.name: warnNoBreakAfterHours
preferences.title: Warn After Continuous Hours Without Break
preferences.description: Trigger a warning if you work this many hours without a break (e.g., 6). Leave empty to disable.

preferences.name: warnDailyHours
preferences.title: Warn After Daily Hours
preferences.description: Trigger a warning if daily hours exceed this value (e.g., 10). Leave empty to disable.

preferences.name: includeWeekends
preferences.title: Include Weekends
preferences.description: Show weekend days (Saturday and Sunday) in the timesheet timeline.
preferences.label: Include Weekends
